caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular metal lantern with an open front, positioned centrally against a plain, beige background. The lantern's frame and surfaces are rendered in tones of gray and brown, with subtle indications of rust and wear along the inner surfaces, giving it a slightly aged appearance. At the bottom center of the lantern's interior is a small, cylindrical metal container that is slightly darker in color, likely intended to be a fuel reservoir or burner. The lantern has a flat top with a projecting, horizontal metal loop or handle above it. There are four small, evenly spaced holes along the bottom edge of the lantern's back wall, near the base. The overall composition is simple and symmetrical, emphasizing the object and its structural details without additional elements or background distractions.
title: Lantern
